headline: Broke Dak Mountain Survives Non Regulators by 6.25 as Joe Mama Angie Daddy Drops 221 on Waffle House
meme_brief: A team wins by 6 points while leaving Alvin Kamara's 16.9 on the bench for a guy who scored half a point, and across town a 221-point outburst turns Waffle House's week into target practice.
recap:
The week's closest call belonged to Broke Dak Mountain, which held off Non Regulators 146.8 to 140.55, a 6.25-point margin that was the nearest thing to drama the league produced. Christian McCaffrey carried Broke Dak Mountain with 51.3 points, and Josh Allen added 30.3, enough to survive a huge night from Non Regulators' Jayden Daniels (34.25) and Chuba Hubbard (33.7). Non Regulators did it to themselves, too: Alvin Kamara sat on the bench and put up 16.9 points while Chris Rodriguez started and managed 0.5, a 16.4-point gap that turned a winnable game into a loss.

Everything else on the slate was a wipeout by comparison. Joe Mama Angie Daddy demolished Waffle House 221.35 to 108.7, the week's biggest blowout by a wide margin, behind Joe Burrow's 49.25 and George Pickens' 41.0 — with Jahmyr Gibbs (42.7) also going off and Brock Purdy posting 48.55 from the bench that didn't even matter. Meredith's Fan Club rolled past Pukachu Chews You 162.1 to 95.8 on the strength of Patrick Mahomes, who put up the league's top individual score at 53.9. Silverbacks beat Screaming Eagles 108.65 to 63.4, and demon44 handled mikelanta 143.7 to 97.0, with Long Live King Henry edging Dak to the Future 151.25 to 139.45.

The week's ugliest bench decision belonged to Screaming Eagles, who started Drake Maye (3.5) over Matthew Stafford, who scored 32.25 from the bench — a 28.75-point gap in a loss. mikelanta also left points on the table, starting Geno Smith (7.4) over J.J. McCarthy (26.05), an 18.65-point miss in a loss to demon44. Both of those are now multi-week habits worth watching.
transaction_desk:
Meredith's Fan Club ran the busiest week in the league, cycling through four moves — the Bengals in, the Bengals out for the Colts, then two separate receiver adds in Adonai Mitchell and Chimere Dike — none of it costing any priority since nobody else wanted those players. It's roster churn, not a real swing, but Adonai Mitchell and Chimere Dike are depth additions worth monitoring on a team that just posted 162 points without needing either of them to start big.

Screaming Eagles made the week's only real priority spend, using their No. 6 slot to add the 49ers defense after dropping Tampa Bay — a modest move with a modest cost, and the early return (1.0 point) isn't going to move the needle either way. Waffle House, picking first in priority order and also sitting at 1-9, used that position efficiently for once: Drew Lock has scored 26.0 points since being added for nothing, and Josh Downs is sitting on 32.3 cumulative points since his week 7 pickup — actual value coming out of a lost season. Dak to the Future's pickup of Wan'Dale Robinson is listed as a possible handcuff of Carnell Tate, which reads as a sensible speculative stash rather than panic, and cost no priority to acquire.

The quieter story remains Joe Mama Angie Daddy's week 6 claim on Tre Tucker, which has produced 54.9 cumulative points for zero priority spent — one of the better value pickups anyone's made all season, on a team that's already running away with the league.

standings_narrative:
Joe Mama Angie Daddy has the top seed locked at 9-1 with Non Regulators (6-4) and Broke Dak Mountain (6-4) rounding out the three division winners who auto-qualify for seeds one through three. Meredith's Fan Club (6-4) and Pukachu Chews You (5-5) currently hold the next-best-record seeds four and five. The sixth and final spot goes not to the next-best record but to whoever has the most total points among the rest of the field, and right now that's Dak to the Future (5-5, 1,219.3 points), holding off mikelanta (4-6, 1,210.9) for the points-based wildcard.

That leaves Long Live King Henry, Screaming Eagles, demon44, Silverbacks, and Waffle House all outside the current picture, though Silverbacks and Screaming Eagles are both 5-5 and within range if the points race shifts. Waffle House, at 1-9, is mathematically still breathing but needs a lot to break right.
look_ahead:
Next week, Non Regulators (6-4) travels to face demon44 (4-6) in a matchup between a division leader trying to shake off this week's loss and a team coming off a blowout win. Joe Mama Angie Daddy (9-1) draws Long Live King Henry (4-6), a clear gap on paper between the league's best record and a team currently on the outside of the playoff picture. Broke Dak Mountain (6-4) faces mikelanta (4-6) after mikelanta's rough week, and Waffle House (1-9) gets a shot at Dak to the Future (5-5), who will be looking to bounce back after dropping a close one.

Silverbacks (5-5) host Meredith's Fan Club (6-4) in a matchup of two teams coming off wins, and Pukachu Chews You (5-5) faces Screaming Eagles (5-5) in a head-to-head between two teams tied in the loss column and both sitting just outside the current playoff cutoff.
